Syarat dan ketentuan
  1. Definisi
    • Apresiasi Spesial adalah fitur dukungan dari pembaca kepada KOMPAS.com dalam bentuk kontribusi finansial melalui platform resmi kami.
    • Kontribusi ini bersifat sukarela dan tidak memberikan hak kepemilikan atau kendali atas konten maupun kebijakan redaksi.
  2. Penggunaan kontribusi
    • Seluruh kontribusi akan digunakan untuk mendukung keberlangsungan layanan, pengembangan konten, dan operasional redaksi.
    • KOMPAS.com tidak berkewajiban memberikan laporan penggunaan dana secara individual kepada setiap kontributor.
  3. Pesan & Komentar
    • Pembaca dapat menyertakan pesan singkat bersama kontribusi.
    • Pesan dalam kolom komentar akan melewati kurasi tim KOMPAS.com
    • Pesan yang bersifat ofensif, diskriminatif, mengandung ujaran kebencian, atau melanggar hukum dapat dihapus oleh KOMPAS.com tanpa pemberitahuan.
  4. Hak & Batasan
    • Apresiasi Spesial tidak dapat dianggap sebagai iklan, investasi, atau kontrak kerja sama komersial.
    • Kontribusi yang sudah dilakukan tidak dapat dikembalikan (non-refundable).
    • KOMPAS.com berhak menutup atau menonaktifkan fitur ini sewaktu-waktu tanpa pemberitahuan sebelumnya.
  5. Privasi & Data
    • Data pribadi kontributor akan diperlakukan sesuai dengan kebijakan privasi KOMPAS.com.
    • Informasi pembayaran diproses oleh penyedia layanan pihak ketiga sesuai dengan standar keamanan yang berlaku.
  6. Pernyataan
    • Dengan menggunakan Apresiasi Spesial, pembaca dianggap telah membaca, memahami, dan menyetujui syarat & ketentuan ini.
  7. Batasan tanggung jawab
    • KOMPAS.com tidak bertanggung jawab atas kerugian langsung maupun tidak langsung yang timbul akibat penggunaan fitur ini.
    • Kontribusi tidak menciptakan hubungan kerja, kemitraan maupun kewajiban kontraktual lain antara Kontributor dan KOMPAS.com

<script type="text/javascript">
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        // Konfigurasi HTTP Headers untuk Fetch API
        const myHeaders = new Headers();
        myHeaders.append("Content-Type", "application/json");

        const requestOptions = {
            method: "GET",
            headers: myHeaders,
            redirect: "follow"
        };

                    const apiUrl = "https://api.kompas.com/apps/bola/lvs_new";
        
        // Mengambil data Live Score dari API Kompas
        fetch(apiUrl, requestOptions)
            .then((response) => {
                if (!response.ok) {
                    throw new Error(`HTTP error! Status: ${response.status}`);
                }
                return response.json(); // Mengubah respon mentah menjadi objek JSON
            })
            .then((result) => {
                const wrapper = document.getElementById('live-score-wrapper');

                // Pengganti fungsi PHP: if (!empty($live_score_bola['data']))
                if (result && result.data && result.data.length > 0) {
                    // Tampilkan widget utama jika ada data pertandingan
                    wrapper.style.display = "block";

                    // Jalankan fungsi untuk membangun struktur HTML internal
                    renderLiveScore(result);
                } else {
                    // Tetap sembunyikan jika data kosong atau tidak ada pertandingan
                    wrapper.style.display = "none";
                }
            })
            .catch((error) => {
                console.error("Gagal mengambil data live score:", error);
                // Sembunyikan widget secara aman jika API offline atau bermasalah
                document.getElementById('live-score-wrapper').style.display = "none";
            });
    });

    /**
     * Fungsi untuk memproses data JSON dan merendernya ke dalam DOM
     */
    function renderLiveScore(match_live) {
        const container = document.getElementById('matchday');
        let html = '';

        match_live.data.forEach((item, index) => {
            const type = item.match_status;
            const homeScore = Number(item.home_score);
            const awayScore = Number(item.away_score);
            const homePenalty = Number(item.home_penalty_score ?? 0);
            const awayPenalty = Number(item.away_penalty_score ?? 0);

            // Cek kondisi adu penalti (Pertandingan selesai, skor seri, dan ada skor penalti)
            const isPenalty = type === 'Completed' && homeScore === awayScore && homePenalty !== awayPenalty;

            // Tentukan format tampilan status waktu
            const status =
                type === 'Upcoming' ? item.match_time :
                    type === 'Ongoing' ? item.match_minute + ''' :
                        isPenalty ? 'FT (P)' : 'FT';

            const title = 'Pertandingan';

            // Tentukan format papan skor
            const score =
                type === 'Upcoming' ? 'vs' :
                    type === 'Ongoing' ? `${homeScore} - ${awayScore}` :
                        isPenalty ? `${homeScore}(${homePenalty}) - ${awayScore}(${awayPenalty})` :
                            `${homeScore} - ${awayScore}`;

            // Normalisasi nama klub untuk kebutuhan URL slug (Slugify)
            const home_name = item.home_club_name.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-');
            const away_name = item.away_club_name.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-');

            // Penentuan URL detail pertandingan
            let url_match = 'https://bola.kompas.com/klasemen';
            const liga = getLigaName(item.competition_id);

            if (liga !== false) {
                url_match = `https://bola.kompas.com/jadwal/${liga}/${item.match_id}/${home_name}-vs-${away_name}?source=living_assistance`;
            }

            if(item.competition_id === 27674) {
                url_match = `https://bola.kompas.com/jadwal/piala-aff/${item.match_id}/${home_name}-vs-${away_name}?source=living_assistance`;
            }

            // Susun elemen HTML per pertandingan
            html += `
            <div class="widgetBox-slider_item la-ticker-slide ${index === 0 ? 'is-active' : ''} --${item.match_status.toLowerCase()}" onclick="javascript:location.href='${url_match}'">
                <div class="widgetBox-label_title">
                    ${title}
                    <span class="matchday-status">${status}</span>
                    <div class="widgetBox-label_logo">
                        <img src="https://asset.kompas.com/data/2026/05/26/kompascom/images/lapangbola.png" alt="Logo Lapangbola">
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="widgetBox-body">
                    <div class="widgetBox-text">
                        <div class="matchdayWidget">
                            <div class="matchdayWidget-team">
                                <div class="matchdayWidget-img">
                                    <img src="${item.home_picture_url}" onerror="this.src='https://asset.kompas.com/data/2021/klasemenliga/unknown-badge.png';">
                                </div>
                                ${item.home_club_short_name}
                            </div>
                            <div class="matchdayWidget-score">${score}</div>
                            <div class="matchdayWidget-team">
                                <div class="matchdayWidget-img">
                                    <img src="${item.away_picture_url}" onerror="this.src='https://asset.kompas.com/data/2021/klasemenliga/unknown-badge.png';">
                                </div>
                                ${item.away_club_short_name}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
        });

        // Masukkan susunan HTML baru ke dalam container #matchday
        container.innerHTML = html;

        // Aktifkan fungsi animasi slider/ticker jika fungsinya tersedia di aplikasi utama
        if (typeof startLaTicker === "function") {
            startLaTicker('.la-ticker-matchday', 7500, 400);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Fungsi untuk memetakan ID Kompetisi menjadi nama liga (URL slug)
     */
    function getLigaName(id) {
        const competitionMap = {
            'liga-indonesia': 27700,
            'liga-inggris': 27690,
            'liga-italia': 27692,
            'liga-spanyol': 'spanyol_id_placeholder',
            'liga-2-indonesia': 27707,
            'timnas-indonesia': 'timnas_id_placeholder',
            'sepaktakuler': 27648,
            'bundesliga': 'bundesliga_id_placeholder',
            'piala-aff': 27674,
            'asean-cup': 27712
        };

        const name = Object.keys(competitionMap).find(
            key => competitionMap[key] === id
        );

        // Memastikan kecocokan data valid, bukan string kosong atau undefined
        return (name !== undefined && name !== '') ? name : false;
    }

<script>
    // ==============================
    // UI: STATUS

    function hideFeedbackControls() {
        document.querySelectorAll(".chatbotFeedback, .chatbotOverview-footer").forEach((el) => {
            el.classList.add("is-hidden");
        });
    }

    function showFeedbackControls() {
        document.querySelectorAll(".chatbotFeedback, .chatbotOverview-footer").forEach((el) => {
            el.classList.remove("is-hidden");
        });
    }

    // ==============================
    // OVERVIEW: SHOW / HIDE / TOGGLE
    // ==============================
    function chatBotOverviewShow() {
        const overview = document.querySelector('.chatbotOverview');
        if (overview) {
            overview.classList.remove('hide');
        }
    }

    function chatBotOverviewHide() {
        const overview = document.querySelector('.chatbotOverview');
        if (overview) {
            overview.classList.add('hide');
        }
    }

    function getChatBotOverviewTopOffset() {
        const fixedHeaders = document.querySelectorAll('.header--sticky .nav, .headerMain-kanal');
        let offset = 0;

        fixedHeaders.forEach((header) => {
            const style = window.getComputedStyle(header);
            if (style.display === 'none' || style.visibility === 'hidden') return;

            const rect = header.getBoundingClientRect();
            const isFixedTop = (style.position === 'fixed' || style.position === 'sticky') && rect.top <= 10 && rect.bottom > 0;

            if (isFixedTop) {
                offset = Math.max(offset, rect.bottom);
            }
        });

        return Math.ceil(offset + 12);
    }

    function scrollToChatBotOverviewTop(overview) {
        const targetTop = window.pageYOffset + overview.getBoundingClientRect().top - getChatBotOverviewTopOffset();
        const startTop = window.pageYOffset;
        const distance = Math.max(targetTop, 0) - startTop;
        const duration = 360;
        const startTime = performance.now();

        if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
            window.scrollTo(0, Math.max(targetTop, 0));
            return;
        }

        function animateScroll(currentTime) {
            const elapsed = currentTime - startTime;
            const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
            const easedProgress = progress < 0.5
                ? 4 * progress * progress * progress
                : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * progress + 2, 3) / 2;

            window.scrollTo(0, startTop + distance * easedProgress);

            if (progress < 1) {
                requestAnimationFrame(animateScroll);
            }
        }

        requestAnimationFrame(animateScroll);
    }

    function chatBotOverviewToggle() {
        const overview = document.querySelector('.chatbotOverview');
        if (!overview) return;

        const toggleBtn = overview.querySelector('.chatbotOverview-toggle');
        const isActive = overview.classList.contains('active');
        const collapsedHeight = 188;

        if (toggleBtn) {
            toggleBtn.textContent = isActive ? 'Baca semua' : 'Sembunyikan';
            toggleBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isActive ? 'false' : 'true');

            // set data event attributes for tracking sembunyikan / baca semua
            toggleBtn.setAttribute('data-event-action', isActive ? 'click baca_semua' : 'click sembunyikan');
            toggleBtn.setAttribute('data-event-label', isActive ? 'Baca semua' : 'Sembunyikan');
            toggleBtn.setAttribute('data-event-category', 'wp_overview');
            toggleBtn.setAttribute('data-event-track', 'click');
        }

        overview.style.height = `${overview.getBoundingClientRect().height}px`;
        overview.offsetHeight;

        if (isActive) {
            overview.classList.remove('active');
            overview.style.height = `${collapsedHeight}px`;
            requestAnimationFrame(() => scrollToChatBotOverviewTop(overview));
        } else {
            overview.classList.add('active');
            overview.style.height = `${overview.scrollHeight}px`;
        }

        overview.addEventListener('transitionend', function onOverviewTransitionEnd(e) {
            if (e.propertyName !== 'height') return;
            overview.removeEventListener('transitionend', onOverviewTransitionEnd);
            overview.style.height = overview.classList.contains('active') ? 'auto' : '';
        });
    }

    // ==============================
    // FEEDBACK: COPY / LIKE / DISLIKE / TRIGGER
    // ==============================
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        const btn = e.target.closest('[data-fb-trigger],[data-fb-copy], .chatbotFeedback-btn, [data-fb-send], [data-fb-cancel]');
        if (!btn) return;

        const box = btn.closest('[data-feedback]');
        if (!box) return;

        const form = box.querySelector('[data-fb-form]');
        const status = box.querySelector('[data-fb-status]');
        const input = box.querySelector('.formInput');
        const copyLabel = box.querySelector('[data-fb-copy-label]');

        // LIKE / DISLIKE
        if (btn.classList.contains('chatbotFeedback-btn') && btn.hasAttribute('data-fb')) {
            const type = btn.getAttribute('data-fb');
            const likeBtn = box.querySelector('.chatbotFeedback-btn[data-fb="good"]');
            const dislikeBtn = box.querySelector('.chatbotFeedback-btn[data-fb="bad"]');

            // toggle off jika klik yang sudah aktif
            if (btn.classList.contains('-active')) {
                btn.classList.remove('-active');
                if (likeBtn) likeBtn.style.display = '';
                if (dislikeBtn) dislikeBtn.style.display = '';
                return;
            }

            if (likeBtn) {
                likeBtn.classList.remove('-active');
                likeBtn.style.display = '';
            }
            if (dislikeBtn) {
                dislikeBtn.classList.remove('-active');
                dislikeBtn.style.display = '';
            }

            if (type === 'good') {
                if (likeBtn) {
                    likeBtn.classList.add('-active');
                }
                if (dislikeBtn) {
                    dislikeBtn.style.display = 'none';
                }
                if (form) form.hidden = true;
                return;
            }

            if (type === 'bad') {
                if (dislikeBtn) {
                    dislikeBtn.classList.add('-active');
                }
                if (likeBtn) {
                    likeBtn.style.display = 'none';
                }
                if (form) form.hidden = true;
                return;
            }
        }
    });

    // ==============================
    // AI OVERVIEW: FETCH & RENDER
    // ==============================
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        const skeleton = document.getElementById('ai-overview-skeleton');
        const topDiv = document.getElementById('ai-overview-top');
        const mainUl = document.getElementById('ai-overview-main');
        const developingDiv = document.getElementById('ai-overview-developing');
        const developingUl = document.getElementById('ai-overview-developing-list');
        const needDiv = document.getElementById('ai-overview-need');
        const mediopods = document.getElementById('btn-mediopods');

        // Show skeleton while loading
        if (skeleton) skeleton.style.display = '';
        if (topDiv) topDiv.style.display = 'none';
        if (mainUl) mainUl.style.display = 'none';
        if (developingDiv) developingDiv.style.display = 'none';
        if (needDiv) needDiv.style.display = 'none';
        if (mediopods) mediopods.style.display = 'none';

        fetch("https://recommendation.kgdata.dev/chrono/v1/wp_aio?t=" + Date.now())
            .then((response) => response.json())
            .then((result) => {
                if (result && result.status_code === 200 && result.data) {
                    // Top Overview
                    if (topDiv && result.data.top_overview) {
                        // replace httpss from cta_html to https if exists
                        if (result.data.top_overview.cta_html) {
                            result.data.top_overview.cta_html = result.data.top_overview.cta_html.replace(/httpss:\/\//g, 'https://');
                        }

                        topDiv.innerHTML =
                            (result.data.top_overview.summary_html || '') +
                            (result.data.top_overview.cta_html ? ' ' + result.data.top_overview.cta_html : '');
                        topDiv.style.display = '';
                    }

                    // Main Issues
                    if (mainUl && Array.isArray(result.data.main_issues)) {
                        mainUl.innerHTML = '';
                        result.data.main_issues.forEach(function (issue) {
                            // replace httpss from cta_html to https if exists
                            if (issue.cta_html) {
                                issue.cta_html = issue.cta_html.replace(/httpss:\/\//g, 'https://');
                            }

                            const li = document.createElement('li');
                            li.innerHTML =
                                '<strong>' + (issue.category || '') + '</strong>: ' +
                                (issue.summary ? issue.summary : '') + ' ' +
                                (issue.cta_html ? issue.cta_html : '');
                            mainUl.appendChild(li);
                        });
                        mainUl.style.display = '';
                    }

                    // Developing Stories
                    if (developingUl && Array.isArray(result.data.developing_stories)) {
                        developingUl.innerHTML = '';
                        result.data.developing_stories.forEach(function (story) {
                            // replace httpss from cta_html to https if exists
                            if (story.cta_html) {
                                story.cta_html = story.cta_html.replace(/httpss:\/\//g, 'https://');
                            }

                            const topic = story.topic || '';
                            const summary = story.summary || '';
                            const ctaHtml = story.cta_html || '';

                            const li = document.createElement('li');
                            li.innerHTML =
                                (topic ? '<strong>' + topic + '</strong>: ' : '') +
                                summary +
                                (ctaHtml ? ' ' + ctaHtml : '');

                            developingUl.appendChild(li);
                        });
                        developingDiv.style.display = '';
                    }

                    // Need to Know
                    if (needDiv && result.data.need_to_know) {
                        const summary = result.data.need_to_know.summary || '';
                        const ctaHtml = result.data.need_to_know.cta_html || '';

                        if (summary || ctaHtml) {
                            needDiv.innerHTML =
                                '<b>Penting untuk diketahui</b>: ' +
                                summary + ' ' + ctaHtml;
                            needDiv.style.display = '';
                        } else {
                            needDiv.style.display = 'none';
                        }
                    }

                    // Mediopods
                    if (mediopods && result.data.studiohub_audio_url) {
                        mediopods.href = result.data.studiohub_audio_url;
                        mediopods.style.display = '';
                    }
                }
            })
            .catch((error) => {
                if (skeleton) skeleton.innerHTML = '<div style="color:red">Gagal memuat data AI Overview.</div>';
            })
            .finally(() => {
                if (skeleton) skeleton.style.display = 'none';
            });
    });


    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        var showBtn = document.querySelector('.chatbotOverview-btn');

        if (!showBtn) return;

        function updateTracking() {
            var textBtn = window.getComputedStyle(showBtn, '::before').content;
            textBtn = textBtn.replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '').toLowerCase();

            var action = (textBtn === 'tampilkan selengkapnya') ? 'click_lihat_selengkapnya' : 'click_lihat_sedikit';

            if (showBtn) {
                showBtn.setAttribute('data-event-track', 'click');
                showBtn.setAttribute('data-event-label', textBtn);
                showBtn.setAttribute('data-event-category', 'wp_overview');
                showBtn.setAttribute('data-event-action', action);
            }
        }

        updateTracking();

        showBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            setTimeout(updateTracking, 0);
        });
    });

</script>

		function initWidgetBsiOnSection() {
			const widgets = document.querySelectorAll('.--widget-bsi');
			if (!widgets.length) return;

			const toggleOnSection = function (widget, isOnSection) {
				widget.classList.toggle('--on_section', isOnSection);
			};

			if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
				widgets.forEach(function (widget) {
					toggleOnSection(widget, true);
				});
				return;
			}

			const observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
				entries.forEach(function (entry) {
					toggleOnSection(entry.target, entry.isIntersecting);
				});
			}, {
				threshold: 0.25
			});

			widgets.forEach(function (widget) {
				observer.observe(widget);
			});
		}

<script>
(function () {
    function getCookie(name) {
        var m = document.cookie.match(new RegExp('(^| )' + name + '=([^;]+)'));
        return m ? decodeURIComponent(m[2]) : '';
    }

    var wrap = document.querySelector('.js-bookmark-wrap');
    var list = document.getElementById('bookmark-list');
    if (!wrap || !list) return;

    var uid = getCookie('kmps_usrid');
    if (!uid) {
        wrap.style.display = 'none';
        return;
    }

    function esc(s) {
        return String(s == null ? '' : s)
            .replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<')
            .replace(/>/g, '>').replace(/"/g, '"');
    }

    function capitalize(t) {
        if (!t) return '';
        return t.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + t.toLowerCase().slice(1);
    }

    // Ambil nama kanal/section/subdomain dari URL item.
    // money.kompas.com -> Money | www.kompas.com/tren/... -> Tren
    // video.kompas.com -> Video | www.kgnow.com/... -> Kgnow
    function channelName(item) {
        var url = (item && item.url) ? String(item.url) : '';
        var channel = '';
        try {
            var a = document.createElement('a');
            a.href = url;
            var host = (a.hostname || '').toLowerCase();
            var path = (a.pathname || '').replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '');
            var sub = host.split('.')[0] || '';
            if (sub === 'www' || sub === 'm' || sub === '') {
                var segs = path.split('/').filter(function (s) { return s.length; });
                channel = segs.length ? segs[0] : '';
            } else {
                channel = sub;
            }
        } catch (e) {
            channel = '';
        }
        if (!channel) {
            channel = (item && item.profile) ? item.profile : ((item && item.type) ? item.type : '');
        }
        // Title Case, ganti dash dengan spasi
        return String(channel).replace(/-/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, function (c) { return c.toUpperCase(); });
    }

    function formatDuration(d) {
        if (!d) return '';
        var parts = String(d).split(':');
        if (parts.length === 3) {
            var h = parseInt(parts[0], 10) || 0;
            var m = parseInt(parts[1], 10) || 0;
            var s = parseInt(parts[2], 10) || 0;
            var pad = function (n) { return (n < 10 ? '0' : '') + n; };
            return h > 0 ? (h + ':' + pad(m) + ':' + pad(s)) : (m + ':' + pad(s));
        }
        return d;
    }

    function timeAgo(v) {
        if (!v) return '';
        var date = new Date(v);
        if (isNaN(date.getTime())) return '';
        var secs = Math.floor((Date.now() - date.getTime()) / 1000);
        var minute = 60, hour = 60 * minute, day = 24 * hour, week = 7 * day, month = 30 * day, year = 365 * day;
        if (secs <= 0) return 'now';
        if (secs < minute) return secs + ' detik lalu';
        if (secs < hour) return Math.round(secs / minute) + ' menit lalu';
        if (secs < day) return Math.round(secs / hour) + ' jam lalu';
        if (secs < week) return Math.round(secs / day) + ' hari lalu';
        if (secs < month) return Math.round(secs / week) + ' minggu lalu';
        if (secs < year) return Math.round(secs / month) + ' bulan lalu';
        return Math.round(secs / year) + ' tahun lalu';
    }

    function buildItem(item, i) {
        var dur = formatDuration(item.duration);
        var duration = dur ? '<div class="latestDuration">' + esc(dur) + '</div>' : '';
        var date = timeAgo(item.created_at);
        var dateHtml = date ? '<li><div class="articlePost-date">' + esc(date) + '</div></li>' : '';
        return '' +
            '<article class="articleItem">' +
                '<a class="article-link" href="' + esc(item.url || '#') + '"' +
                    ' data-event-category="content_click_wp"' +
                    ' data-event-action="click bookmark"' +
                    ' data-event-label="' + (i + 1) + '"' +
                    ' data-event-track="click">' +
                    '<div class="articleItem-wrap">' +
                        '<div class="articleItem-img">' +
                            duration +
                            '<img src="' + esc(item.photo || '') + '" alt="' + esc(item.title || '') + '" />' +
                        '</div>' +
                        '<div class="articleItem-box">' +
                            '<h3 class="articleTitle">' + esc(item.title || '') + '</h3>' +
                            '<div class="articlePost"><ul>' +
                                '<li class="-cfull"><div class="articlePost-subtitle">' + esc(channelName(item)) + '</div></li>' +
                                dateHtml +
                            '</ul></div>' +
                        '</div>' +
                    '</div>' +
                '</a>' +
            '</article>';
    }

    fetch('https://api.kompas.com/2021/reaction/bookmark/list?kmps_usrid=' + encodeURIComponent(uid) + '&limit=3', {
        method: 'GET'
    })
    .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
    .then(function (res) {
        if (!res || !res.status || !Array.isArray(res.data) || res.data.length === 0) {
            wrap.style.display = 'none';
            return;
        }
        list.innerHTML = res.data.slice(0, 3).map(buildItem).join('');
        wrap.style.display = '';
    })
    .catch(function () {
        wrap.style.display = 'none';
    });
})();
</script>

<script>
    const myHeaders = new Headers();

    const requestOptions = {
        method: "GET",
        headers: myHeaders,
        redirect: "follow"
    };

    fetch("https://apis.kompas.com/api/comment/v2/widget", requestOptions)
        .then(response => response.json())
        .then(result => {

            let html = '';

            // ambil 5 komentar terbaru
            result.slice(0, 5).forEach((article, index) => {

                if (!article.detail || article.detail.length === 0) {
                    return;
                }

                const comment = article.detail[0];

                let isiKomentar = '';

                // komentar teks
                if (comment.type === 'text') {
                    isiKomentar = comment.komentar;
                }

                // komentar sticker/gif
                if (comment.type === 'sticker') {
                    isiKomentar = `
                    <img src="${comment.komentar}"
                         alt="Sticker"
                         style="max-width:80px">
                `;
                }

                // format waktu
                const waktu = new Date(comment.waktu_komentar * 1000);

                html += `
                <div class="commentWidget-item p-16 radius-12 bg-elevation-1 flex-column-gap12">

                    <a href="${article.url_page}?source=wp_widget_komentar_terbaru"
                       class="commentWidget-box flex-row-start-start-gap12 text-no-decoration"
                       data-event-category="content_click_wp"
                       data-event-action="click komentar terbaru"
                       data-event-label="${index + 1}"
                       data-event-track="click">

                        <div class="commentWidget-img">
                            <div class="img-ratio img-ratio-1 bg-neutral-50">
                                <img src="${article.photo}"
                                     alt="${article.title}">
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div class="commentWidget-title">
                            <div class="text-p3-bold cl-txt-800 ellipsis-3">
                                ${article.title}
                            </div>
                        </div>

                    </a>

                    <div class="commentWidget-cm">
                        <div class="flex-row-start-center-gap8 mb-4">
                            <span class="text-c1-bold cl-txt-800">
                                ${comment.nama}
                            </span>

                            <span class="text-c2-reg cl-txt-600">
                                ${timeAgo(comment.waktu_komentar)}
                            </span>
                        </div>

                        <div class="text-p3-reg cl-txt-600 ellipsis-3 -lh-13">
                            ${isiKomentar}
                        </div>
                    </div>

                </div>
            `;
            });

            document.getElementById('commentWidget').innerHTML = html;
        })
        .catch(error => {
            console.error(error);

            document.getElementById('commentWidget').innerHTML =
                '<p>Gagal memuat komentar.</p>';
        });

    function timeAgo(timestamp) {
        const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
        const diff = now - timestamp;

        if (diff < 60) {
            return `${diff} detik lalu`;
        }

        const minutes = Math.floor(diff / 60);
        if (minutes < 60) {
            return `${minutes} menit lalu`;
        }

        const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
        if (hours < 24) {
            return `${hours} jam lalu`;
        }

        const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);
        if (days < 30) {
            return `${days} hari lalu`;
        }

        const months = Math.floor(days / 30);
        if (months < 12) {
            return `${months} bulan lalu`;
        }

        const years = Math.floor(months / 12);
        return `${years} tahun lalu`;
    }

        var name = cname + "=";
        var decodedCookie = decodeURIComponent(document.cookie);
        var ca = decodedCookie.split(';');
        for (var i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
            var c = ca[i];
            while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') {
                c = c.substring(1);
            }
            if (c.indexOf(name) == 0) {
                return c.substring(name.length, c.length);
            }
        }
        return "";
    }

            document.cookie = name + "=" +

                let isKomik = url.includes('/komik/');

                    title = title.replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, ' ');
                    title_wa = title_wa.replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, ' ');
                    title_tele = title_tele.replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, ' ');

                }

                modals.find('#copyLinkUrl').html(copy_link);
                modals.find('.buttonFacebook').attr("onclick", `fb_share('${title}','${url}?utm_source=Facebook&utm_medium=Referral&utm_campaign=${utm_campaign}')`);
                if(title.length < 200){
                    modals.find('.buttonTwitter').attr("onclick", `tweet_share('${title}\\n\\n`+title_klik+`: ${url}?utm_source=Twitter&utm_medium=Referral&utm_campaign=${utm_campaign}${tagline_tw}')`);
                }else{
                    modals.find('.buttonTwitter').attr("onclick", `tweet_share('${title}\\n\\n`+title_klik+`: ${url}?utm_source=Twitter&utm_medium=Referral&utm_campaign=${utm_campaign}')`);
                }
                modals.find('.buttonWhatsapp').attr("onclick", `whatsapp_share_new('${title_wa}', '${url}?utm_source=Whatsapp&utm_medium=Referral&utm_campaign=${utm_campaign}${tagline_wa}')`);
                modals.find('.buttonLine').attr("href", `https://line.me/R/msg/text/?${title}%0D%0A%0D%0A`+title_klik+`:%0D%0A${url}%3Futm_source=Line%26utm_medium=Referral%26utm_campaign=${utm_campaign}${tagline_ln}`);
                modals.find('.buttonTelegram').attr("onclick", `telegram_share('${title_tele}', '${url}?utm_source=Telegram&utm_medium=Referral&utm_campaign=${utm_campaign}', '${tagline_tg}')`);
            }

            openModal('reaction-share');
        });

        // Add dismiss button handler
        $('body').on('click', '.reactionModal .modalDismiss', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            closeModal('reaction-share');
        });
    })();

    function custom_utm_campaign() {

        
        
        
        if (window.location.hostname.indexOf('activity') == 0) {
            if (window.location.pathname == '/saved') {
                return 'Saved_Desktop'
            } else if (window.location.pathname == '/like') {
                return 'Liked_Desktop'
            }
        } else {
            var el_socmedList = document.querySelector('.socmedList');
            if (!!el_socmedList) {
                var data_area = el_socmedList.getAttribute('data-area');
                if (data_area == 'top') {
                    return 'Top_Desktop'
                } else if (data_area == 'bottom') {
                    return 'Bottom_Desktop'
                } else {
                    return 'AIML_Widget_Desktop'
                }
            }
        }

        return 'Sticky_Desktop'
    }

<script>
	const MIN_AMOUNT_V2 = 5000;
	
	function giftV2Modal() {
	    return document.querySelector('[data-modal-target="modal-gift-membership"]')
	        || document.getElementById('kcm-modals')?.querySelector('.modalContent.giftModal');
	}
	
	function giftV2Panel(modal) {
	    if (!modal) return null;
	    const typeInput = modal.querySelector('input[name="membership_type"]:checked');
	    const t = typeInput ? typeInput.value : 'once';
	    return modal.querySelector('.membershipOptions-item[data-type="' + t + '"]');
	}
	
	function giftV2Wrap(modal) {
	    if (!modal) return null;
	    const oncePanel = modal.querySelector('.membershipOptions-item[data-type="once"]');
	    return oncePanel ? oncePanel.querySelector('.formInput-wrap.customAmount') : null;
	}
	
	function giftV2CustomShow() {
	    const modal = giftV2Modal();
	    const wrap = giftV2Wrap(modal);
	    if (!wrap) return;
	
	    const typeInput = modal.querySelector('input[name="membership_type"]:checked');
	    const isOnce = typeInput && typeInput.value === 'once';
	    const oncePanel = modal.querySelector('.membershipOptions-item[data-type="once"]');
	    const lainnyaSelected = !!(oncePanel && oncePanel.querySelector('input[name="price"][value="Lainnya"]:checked'));
	
	    wrap.style.display = isOnce && lainnyaSelected ? '' : 'none';
	}
	
	function giftV2IsLainnya(modal) {
	    if (!modal) return false;
	    const typeInput = modal.querySelector('input[name="membership_type"]:checked');
	    if (!typeInput || typeInput.value !== 'once') return false;
	    const oncePanel = modal.querySelector('.membershipOptions-item[data-type="once"]');
	    return !!(oncePanel && oncePanel.querySelector('input[name="price"][value="Lainnya"]:checked'));
	}
	
	function giftV2Error(modal, customInput) {
	    const wrap = giftV2Wrap(modal);
	    const errEl = modal?.querySelector('#customAmountError');
	    if (!wrap || !errEl) return;
	
	    const lainnyaCustom = giftV2IsLainnya(modal);
	    if (!lainnyaCustom) {
	        errEl.style.display = 'none';
	        wrap.classList.remove('--error');
	        return;
	    }
	
	    const raw = String(customInput?.value ?? '').replace(/[^\d]/g, '');
	    const num = raw === '' ? NaN : parseInt(raw, 10);
	    const tooLow = raw !== '' && !isNaN(num) && num < MIN_AMOUNT_V2;
	
	    if (tooLow) {
	        errEl.style.display = '';
	        wrap.classList.add('--error');
	    } else {
	        errEl.style.display = 'none';
	        wrap.classList.remove('--error');
	    }
	}
	
	function giftV2FormValid() {
	    const modal = giftV2Modal();
	    if (!modal) return false;
	
	    const panel = giftV2Panel(modal);
	    if (!panel) return false;
	
	    const selectedPrice = panel.querySelector('input[name="price"]:checked');
	    if (!selectedPrice) return false;
	
	    const customInput = modal.querySelector('#customAmount');
	    const val = selectedPrice.value;
	    const dataAmt = selectedPrice.getAttribute('data-amount') || '';
	    const isLainnya = val === 'Lainnya' || dataAmt === 'Lainnya';
	    if (isLainnya) {
	        const raw = String(customInput?.value ?? '').replace(/[^\d]/g, '');
	        const num = raw === '' ? NaN : parseInt(raw, 10);
	        return !isNaN(num) && num >= MIN_AMOUNT_V2;
	    }
	    return true;
	}
	
	function giftV2SubmitLabel(modal) {
	    const button = modal?.querySelector('#btn-submit');
	    if (!button) return;
	
	    const typeInput = modal.querySelector('input[name="membership_type"]:checked');
	    const membershipType = typeInput ? typeInput.value : 'once';
	
	    let nextLabel = 'Kirim apresiasi';
	
	    if (membershipType !== 'once') {
	        const panel = giftV2Panel(modal);
	        const checkedPrice = panel?.querySelector('input[name="price"]:checked');
	        const priceLabelText = checkedPrice?.closest('label')?.querySelector('span')?.textContent?.trim() || '';
	        nextLabel = priceLabelText ? ('Gabung dengan ' + priceLabelText) : 'Gabung sekarang';
	    }
	
	    // Avoid observer loop: only write DOM when label actually changes.
	    if (button.textContent !== nextLabel) {
	        button.textContent = nextLabel;
	    }
	}
	
	function giftV2Submit() {
	    const modal = giftV2Modal();
	    const button = modal?.querySelector('#btn-submit');
	    if (!button) return;
	
	    giftV2CustomShow();
	    giftV2SubmitLabel(modal);
	
	    const panel = giftV2Panel(modal);
	    const customInput = modal?.querySelector('#customAmount');
	
	    if (!panel) {
	        button.setAttribute('disabled', 'disabled');
	        giftV2Error(modal, customInput);
	        return;
	    }
	
	    const ok = giftV2FormValid();
	
	    if (ok) {
	        button.removeAttribute('disabled');
	    } else {
	        button.setAttribute('disabled', 'disabled');
	    }
	
	    giftV2Error(modal, customInput);
	}
	
	document.addEventListener('input', function (e) {
	    if (e.target && e.target.id === 'customAmount' && giftV2Modal()?.contains(e.target)) {
	        giftV2Submit();
	    }
	});
	
	document.addEventListener('change', function (e) {
	    if (!e.target) return;
	    const modal = giftV2Modal();
	    if (!modal || !modal.contains(e.target)) return;
	
	    if (e.target.matches('input[name="price"]') || e.target.matches('input[name="membership_type"]')) {
	        giftV2Submit();
	    }
	}, true);
	
	document.addEventListener('blur', function (e) {
	    if (e.target && e.target.id === 'customAmount' && giftV2Modal()?.contains(e.target)) {
	        giftV2Submit();
	    }
	}, true);

	    const priceRadio = e.target.closest('input[name="price"]');
	    const priceLabel = e.target.closest('.radioOptions-item');
	    const labelInput = priceLabel && priceLabel.querySelector('input[name="price"]');
	    if (priceRadio || labelInput) {
	        requestAnimationFrame(giftV2Submit);
	    }
	}, true);
	
	document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
	    giftV2Submit();
	});
	
	(function () {
	    const root = document.getElementById('kcm-modals');
	    if (!root) return;
	    const observer = new MutationObserver(function () {
	        giftV2Submit();
	    });
	    observer.observe(root, { childList: true, subtree: true });
	})();

    function updateSubmitButtonStateV2() {
        const submitButton = document.getElementById('btn-submit');
        if (!submitButton) return;
        
        const activeTabInput = document.querySelector('input[name="membership_type"]:checked');
        if (!activeTabInput) {
            submitButton.disabled = true;
            return;
        }
        
        const membershipType = activeTabInput.value;
        const activeOptionsContainer = document.querySelector(`.membershipOptions-item[data-type="${membershipType}"]`);
        if (!activeOptionsContainer) {
            submitButton.disabled = true;
            return;
        }
        
        const selectedPriceInput = activeOptionsContainer.querySelector('input[name="price"]:checked');
        let isValid = false;

        if (selectedPriceInput) {
            if (membershipType === 'once' && selectedPriceInput.value === 'Lainnya') {
                const customAmountInput = document.getElementById('customAmount');
                const amount = customAmountInput && customAmountInput.dataset.raw 
                                ? Number(customAmountInput.dataset.raw) 
                                : Number(customAmountInput.value.replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''));
                if (amount >= 5000) {
                    isValid = true;
                }
            } else {
                isValid = true;
            }
        }

        submitButton.disabled = !isValid;
    }

    function getCookieSuperThanks(name) {
        var name = name + '=';
        var cookies = decodeURIComponent(document.cookie).split(';');
        for (var i = 0; i < cookies.length; i++) {
            var c = cookies[i];
            while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') {
                c = c.substring(1);
            }
            if (c.indexOf(name) == 0) {
                return c.substring(name.length, c.length);
            }
        }
        return '';
    }

function setCookie(name,value,hour) {
    var expires = "";
    if (hour) {
        var date = new Date();
        date.setTime(date.getTime() + (hour*60*60*1000));
        expires = "; expires=" + date.toUTCString();
    }
    document.cookie = name + "=" + (value || "")  + expires + "; ;domain=.kompas.com;path=/";
}

function getCookie(cname) {
    var name = cname + "=";
    var decodedCookie = decodeURIComponent(document.cookie);
    var ca = decodedCookie.split(';');
    for(var i = 0; i <ca.length; i++) {
        var c = ca[i];
        while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') {
        c = c.substring(1);
        }
        if (c.indexOf(name) == 0) {
        return c.substring(name.length, c.length);
        }
    }
    return "";
}

    <script>
var modals_content = document.querySelector('.modals__content');
let swiperInstance = null; // Global swiper instance

function modalOpen(modalsId, ov_close) {
    showModals(modalsId, ov_close);
}

function showModals(modalsId, ov_close, swiperSlide) {
    var md = document.getElementById('kcm-modals');
    var md_id = document.getElementById(modalsId);

    if (!!md) {
        if (!!md_id) {
            // Clear previous content
            var fc = md.firstElementChild;
            clearModalsContent(fc);

            // Create overlay dynamically
            if (!!ov_close) {
                const overlay = document.createElement('div');
                overlay.classList.add('overlay');
                overlay.setAttribute('onclick', 'dismissModals()');

                md.appendChild(overlay);
                document.body.classList.add('w-overlay');
            }

            // Add body class and clone element
            document.body.classList.add('modals');
            var ox = md_id.cloneNode(true);
            fc.appendChild(ox);

            if (!swiperSlide) {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    if (typeof initializeSwiper === 'function') {
                        initializeSwiper();
                    }
                }, 10);
            }
        } else {
            console.log('unknown modal target');
            return;
        }
    } else {
        console.log('template modals not found');
        return;
    }
}

function dismissModals() {
    var md = document.getElementById('kcm-modals');
    if (!!md) {
        if (document.body.classList.contains('modals') || document.body.classList.contains('w-overlay')) {
            document.body.classList.remove('modals', 'w-overlay');
        }

        var fc = md.firstElementChild;
        clearModalsContent(fc);

        // Remove overlay
        removeOverlay();

        // Destroy Swiper instance to avoid duplication
        if (swiperInstance instanceof Swiper) {
            swiperInstance.destroy(true, true);
            swiperInstance = null;
        }
    }
}

function clearModalsContent(el) {
    while (el.firstChild) {
        el.removeChild(el.firstChild);

        if (document.body.classList.contains('modals') || document.body.classList.contains('w-overlay')) {
            document.body.classList.remove('modals', 'w-overlay');
        }
        document.body.classList.remove('w-overlay');
    }
}

function removeOverlay() {
    document.querySelector('.overlay')?.remove();
}

function refresh_slider(){

        'hujan': ['hujan', 'hujan ringan', 'hujan lebat', 'hujan lembat', 'hujan lembab', 'hujan berawan'],
        'berkabut': ['kabut', 'berkabut'],
        'berangin': ['angin', 'berangin'],
        'dingin': ['dingin'],
        'badai': ['badai']
    };

    const hour = new Date().getHours();
    const isNight = hour >= 18 || hour < 6;

    for (const [type, conditions] of Object.entries(weatherTypes)) {
        if (conditions.includes(weather)) {
            return ['cerah', 'cerah-berawan', 'berkabut'].includes(type) && isNight ? type + '-malam' : type;

            refresh_slider();
        })
        .catch(error => { 
            console.error(error);
        });
    });

    function formatPercent(string) {
        const value = parseFloat(string.replace('%', '').trim());
        if (value == 0) {
            return '(0%)';
        }

        const sign = value >= 0 ? '+' : '-';
        const format_number = Math.abs(value).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',');

        return `(${sign}${format_number}%)`;
    }

    function formatToJt(num) {
        if (!num) return "0";

        const val = num / 1000000;
        if (Number.isInteger(val)) {
            return val + " jt";
        }
        return val.toFixed(2).replace(/\.0+$/, "").replace(".", ",") + " jt";
    }
</script>

            "bekasi":    { province: "Jawa Barat",       regency: "Kota Bekasi" }
        };
    
        let regencyValue = "";
        let provinceValue = "";

        const config = locationConfig[cityLower] || null;

        if (config) {            
            provinceValue = config.province;
            regencyValue  = config.regency;
        } else {                        
            provinceValue = ""; 
                        
            const formatted = cityLower.split(' ')
                .map(w => w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1))
                .join(' ');
                
            regencyValue = "Kota " + formatted;
        }
        
        function toLocalISOString(date) {
            const offset = date.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000;
            const localDate = new Date(date.getTime() - offset);
            return localDate.toISOString().slice(0, 19);
        }
        
        const thirtyMinutesAgo = new Date(now.getTime() - (30 * 60 * 1000));
        
        const isoFrom = toLocalISOString(thirtyMinutesAgo);
        const isoTo   = toLocalISOString(now);
        const sqlFrom = isoFrom.replace('T', ' ');
        const sqlTo   = isoTo.replace('T', ' ');
        
        const buildUrl = (baseUrl, params) => {
            const url = new URL(baseUrl);
            Object.keys(params).forEach(key => {
                
                if (params[key]) {
                    url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]);
                }
            });
            return url.toString();
        };

            province: provinceValue, 
            regency: regencyValue    
        };

                    if (result.data && result.data.records && result.data.records.length > 0) {
                        const records = result.data.records;
                        const uniqueTitles = new Set();

                        records.forEach(item => {
                            if (item.title && typeof item.title === 'string') {
                                uniqueTitles.add(item.title.trim());
                            } else {
                                const fallbackId = item.id || item.sourceId || Math.random().toString();
                                uniqueTitles.add('__no_title__' + fallbackId);

                        });

                    url_match = 'https://bola.kompas.com/jadwal/' + liga + '/' + item.match_id + '/' + home_name + '-vs-' + away_name+ '?source=living_assistance';
                }

                html += `
                    <div class="widgetBox-slider_item la-ticker-slide ${index === 0 ? 'is-active' : ''} --${item.match_status.toLowerCase()}" onclick="javascript:location.href='${url_match}'">
                        <div class="widgetBox-label_title">
                            ${title}
                            <span class="matchday-status">${status}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="widgetBox-body">
                            <div class="widgetBox-text">
                                <div class="matchdayWidget">
                                    <div class="matchdayWidget-team">
                                        <div class="matchdayWidget-img">
                                            <img src="${item.home_picture_url}" onerror="this.src='https://asset.kompas.com/data/2021/klasemenliga/unknown-badge.png';">
                                        </div>
                                        ${item.home_club_short_name}
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="matchdayWidget-score">${score}</div>
                                    <div class="matchdayWidget-team">
                                        <div class="matchdayWidget-img">
                                            <img src="${item.away_picture_url}" onerror="this.src='https://asset.kompas.com/data/2021/klasemenliga/unknown-badge.png';">
                                        </div>
                                        ${item.away_club_short_name}
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            });

            container.innerHTML = html;
            startLaTicker('.la-ticker-matchday', 7500, 400);
        }
    });

    function getLigaName(id) {
        const competitionMap = {
            'liga-indonesia' : 27700,
            'liga-inggris' : 27690, 
            'liga-italia' : 27692,
            'liga-spanyol' : '',
            'liga-2-indonesia' : 27707,
            'timnas-indonesia' : '',
            'sepaktakuler' : 27648,
            'bundesliga' : '',
            'asean-cup' : 27712
        };

        const name = Object.keys(competitionMap).find(
            key => competitionMap[key] === id
        );

        return name !== undefined || name !== '' ? name : false;
    }
</script>
